steps.content: In the space of that moment, an explosion she knows in her bones detonates in front of Murphy.
The shackles' crimson light sears across the length of the corridor, sending every monster in her path flying.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Why...
You simply reach out and offer your hand before her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Because you think running away will fix everything.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: But that's how it's supposed to be!
She raises her voice at you for the first time.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: If I hadn't gotten close to you all, Chief ${PlayerName} wouldn't have been hurt!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: If I'd just run further away sooner, that thing wouldn't have gone after everyone!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: The Bureau turned out like this, and even this place itself wants to crush me—

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Doesn't that prove it?! Everything is because of me!
Her voice dies away, and the silence rushes in. Yet you, too, have something to say to the girl in front of you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If everything really only gets worse because of you, then why hasn't a single person standing here left?
You shift your weight, stepping just aside, and from behind you several familiar silhouettes emerge.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: You all...
Murphy hesitates, then asks the question she has asked so many times before.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>So... we're still friends?</color>

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You keep saying you bring bad luck to everyone, but honestly, for Sinners... it's really not that bad.
The instant you finish, those beside you fix you with subtly pointed stares.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Because... you have never, ever tried to use your misfortune to hurt anyone on purpose, Murphy.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Correct. Mania overflow is unavoidable. It could happen to anyone.
With the shackles' intervention, Norma patches the forcibly severed comms back through, and the channel stirs to life with a swell of voices.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe... well... the misfortune's still a little bit of a hassle, sure, but once you get used to it, it's actually kind of fun!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Yeah! At this point, if you weren't around, I'd probably forget how to aim!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, face Mania together with us. We need you.
Murphy stares at you, her expression frozen.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Whoa... That actually worked?! Chief, did you see that?! Wasn't I amazing just now?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Didn't you just say we'd lose even harder?

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Even if it means burning up all my luck for the next twenty years. No, wait, what luck do I even have?! Fine! Then I'll stake every bit of bad luck from my entire life!

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: If this could be my everyday life... that wouldn't be so bad.

steps.speaker: Murphy
steps.content: Wait for me!
Dear Murphy, don't listen to them.
The incarnation of misfortune rips through Mania and surges forth, blasting your group apart across the platform without resistance.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Accept me. I am you. From this moment on, I will carry all your misfortune. I will savor the endless suffering in your place!
The moment its words die away, monsters pour out in a crushing tide.
